author: independent critic pair for python-final-mcq (education reviewer and Python/pytest/psycopg/FastAPI SME reviewer, one model session acting as both roles, plus recorder; did not author the bank), 2026-11-19; SME review of all 30 items and the blueprint. Keys for 29 of 30 items executed in a throwaway venv (Python 3.14, pydantic 2.14.4, fastapi 0.165.0, httpx 0.28.1, pytest; q26 and q27 on a real PostgreSQL via a temporary pgserver cluster with psycopg 3; q15 page-grounded). Verdict: approve, 0 critical, 0 high, 0 medium, 3 low.

findings.claim: The item expects the learner to know PostgreSQL rejects text > integer. The ELT page teaches only that staging columns are usually text and need casting; the failure itself is an inference. Executed on PostgreSQL: 'operator does not exist: text > integer', the DELETE rolls back, and yesterday's row stays. The stem states the text column and the key is unique.

Both turn on the httpx exception hierarchy but on different deciding facts: q06 is ConnectError under TransportError (502, localhost base URL), q29 is ReadTimeout under TimeoutException escaping uncaught (500). Executed: q29 returns 500 against a stalled socket. Cross-checked against the checkpoint: sfcp-q13 decides on raise_for_status, so no shared deciding fact.

The key is page-grounded rather than executed as a scenario. The module page states python -m pip is the pip of the active Python and has an activity that runs python -m pip freeze. Behaviour matches the key: freeze records the interpreter that runs it.
